observations: Photo 0 shows a large, yellowish-brown engine with visible wear and oil residue. It has a black plastic cover on top, with a rectangular opening in the center. Various hoses, pipes, and a white filter are attached. The engine appears to be in a workshop or storage area.

Photo 1 shows the same engine from a top-down angle. The black plastic cover has a label with 'CAT' and '5.3' visible. There are also two white stickers with text, possibly part numbers or model info. The engine block is dirty and shows signs of use. A person in orange work pants is visible in the background.
The engine has a complex array of components: intake manifold, fuel lines, cooling system, and electrical connectors. No visible signs of recent operation or testing.
The seller claims it is a 'complete caterpiller c9 engine (parts)' and 'tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.'

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the 'CAT' logo and '5.3' on the cover, which is consistent with Caterpillar engines, but no visible parts list or proof of completeness. The engine appears to be a 5.3L model, but 'C9' is not visible in either photo. The seller's claim of 'complete' cannot be verified from the photos.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may not be a Caterpillar C9 or may be damaged internally.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with visible casting numbers or serial number, and a photo of the complete set of parts included (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft, sensors, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Caterpillar 5.3L engine, not as a C9, which would be worth more.

risks.risk: Engine may be non-functional or have hidden mechanical issues (e.g., worn bearings, cracked block, seized components).
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a photo of the engine being tested, or a close-up of the oil pan and cylinder head for signs of wear or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since 'tested and working' is unverified.

risks.risk: Parts may be missing or incomplete despite the 'complete' claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included parts laid out, or a list of parts included with the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
A clear photo of the engine block with visible casting numbers or serial number.
A photo showing all included parts laid out.
A video of the engine running or a photo of the engine being tested.
A photo of the complete set of parts included.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
